Every row is one Seller's Model Listing at the build's fetch time; the table stays flat and is sorted by estimated cost for your token mix. The same model can appear as several listings from different Sellers — first-party and reseller prices sit side by side, and the page never merges or groups them. Creator names are each Seller's published owner, normalized to one display spelling. Sellers quoting USD are converted with the unrounded ECB reference rate shown above; native per-million rates stay visible in the price details. Calculations use unrounded values and display rounding only. When no cached-input price is published, the input rate is used as an estimate and marked with ⚠. This does not mean the Seller publishes or supports prompt caching. Fully free listings do not show this warning because the fallback cannot change their cost. Listings from a Seller whose refresh failed are marked stale ⚠ per Seller and dropped after seven days.

Newest first · 1 recorded day of change. Entries appear automatically whenever the daily data fetch changes a price, model, or plan.
